department: Biomedical Engineering, Schaefer School of Engineering and Science

deadline.value: The preferred Ph.D. deadline for Fall is January 15, so applying by then gives the best chance of funding consideration. The page gives no year, so 2027 is inferred.

also.quote: Applications submitted by February 1st are guaranteed to receive full consideration for a funded Ph.D. student position

gre_general.value: The Biomedical Engineering page says the GRE or GMAT is optional.
gre_general.quote: A competitive GRE or GMAT score (optional)

gre_subject.value: The Biomedical Engineering page does not mention a subject test.

supervisor.value: The Biomedical Engineering page says students study under a faculty mentor but does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Funded positions are limited; applications after February 1 are considered only if positions remain.
funding.quote: Applications are also welcome to be submitted after February 1st, and will be considered for funded Ph.D. student positions that remain available

entry_route.value: Applicants entering after a bachelor's degree must first complete a preliminary 30-credit master's degree.
